caption:
Global Metadata: A lyrical Vietnamese traditional piece, 76 BPM, gentle and plaintive. Centered on the đàn bầu (monochord zither) with its unique flexible, wavering, resonant plucked tone produced by harmonics, joined by a soft bamboo flute and a light wooden percussion. The đàn bầu plays a melancholic, ornamented melody with its characteristic gliding microtonal bends, the bamboo flute answers with a breathy line, and the piece unfolds gently to a quiet, tender ending. Production profile: close, intimate Vietnamese traditional recording, warm resonant đàn bầu tone, soft breathy flute, studio mastering with generous dynamic range.

Vocal Details: No vocals at all. Purely instrumental. Do not add any singing, humming, or voice.

Arrangement: Intro, the đàn bầu plays a soft ornamented melody with gliding bends. Section one, the bamboo flute answers with a breathy gentle line. Section two, the đàn bầu and flute weave together over soft wooden percussion. Section three, the music grows a little warmer. Outro, a quiet tender ending and a soft fade.
